canonicalFacts.claim: Beta-blockers as first-line therapy for hypertension are inferior to other antihypertensive drug classes for cardiovascular outcomes
Dietary salt reduction leads to considerable blood pressure reduction, especially in hypertensive patients
Aerobic exercise is useful adjunctive therapy in treating hypertension with minimal side effects
Methyldopa and labetalol are first-choice antihypertensive agents for women planning pregnancy
ACE inhibitors and ARBs need to be withdrawn in women planning pregnancy

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Reduce dietary salt intake to lower blood pressure
Engage in regular aerobic exercise as adjunctive therapy
Implement intensive lifestyle interventions including weight reduction in obese hypertensive patients

redFlags: Energy drink consumption can cause severe hypertension and stroke
Bezafibrate may cause rhabdomyolysis when combined with other medications
